inputs.name: VerificationRecordValidator.validate.value
inputs.description: The untrusted value supplied to validate for schema parsing. The parameter accepts any runtime value; only values accepted by verificationRecordSchema receive measurement and recorded-unit checks.

outputs.name: VerificationRecordValidator.validate
outputs.description: The ManifestValidation<VerificationRecord> result produced by validate. Schema failures return errors without value; parsed records return value plus findings for measurement inconsistencies or units lacking recorded component versions.

errors: record: source.commit must be a full commit or tree hash
